page.layout: Two printed columns on one page, left and right, with no margin notes. Left column: entries from the start of the page through to the foot. Right column: entries to its foot, ending with "Rad." on the last line. Page number at top left. Running head at top, Hebrew letters on each side. No headings, catchwords or signatures. The "Digitized by Google" banner is left out.

main_text.p: מַעֲצוּמֵיהֶם consilia sua, vel מוֹעֲצוֹתֵיהֶם [?] & a consiliis suis, No. pl. fæm. præf aff. à f. fæm. מוֹעֲצָה [?] Rad. יָעַץ consuluit.
מַעֲקָה lorica, No. f. m. Rad. עָקָה.
כְּמִשְׁפַּט [?] secundum nuditatem, No. f. m. præf. R. עָרָה.
מַעֲרָה, constr. מַעֲרַת nuditas, No. f. m. Rad. עָרָה nudari.
מְעָרוֹת spelunca, No. pl. fæm. à sing. fæm. מְעָרָה, constr. מְעָרוֹת; R. עָרָה.
מַעֲרֶךָ nuditas tua, No. f. m. מַעַר, aff. R. עָרָה.
מַעֲשִׂים opera, מַעֲשֵׂיכֶם vestra, &c. No. pl. m. aff à f. m. מַעֲשֵׂה; Rad. עָשָׂה.
הַמַּעֲבִיר transferens, Part. Hiph. f. m. R. עָבַר veterascere, transferri.
מַפָּז pre auro puro, pro מִן פָּז, præf. R. פָּזַז consolidari.
מִסַּסָּא [?] subsiliens, Part. Piel, f. m. R. פָּסַס.
מְפֻזָּר dispersus, Part. Pual, f. m. R. פָּזַר.
מַפָּח expiratio, מַפָּח follis, No. f. m. R. נָפַח spiravit.
מָפַחַד pavens, Part. piel, f. m. R. פָּחַד.
מַפִּיל cadere faciens, Part. Hiph. f. m. R. נָפַל.
מַפִּיץ dispergens, malleus, וּמַפִּיצִים & dispergentes, vel mallei, Part. Hiph. vel, No. Part. f. & pl. m. R. פּוּץ.
מַפִּיקִים proferentes, Part. Hiph. pl. m. à f. m. מַפִּיק, Rad. פּוּק [?].
מַפְכִּים manantes, Part. Piel, pl. m. Rad. in Piel, מַפְכָּה.
מַפַּל quisquiliæ, No. f. m. Rad.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and several consonants are blurred in the scan, and the Hebrew forms are marked [?] where uncertain. Left-column line "præf aff. à f. fæm." and the "vel" line are faint. The word "subsiliens" is read from a blurred line. The running heads are Hebrew letter pairs and are doubtful. The final entry on the right is cut off at the foot of the scan and continues on the next page.
